Card Q&A.a: The player that uses this card gains memory.
Card Q&A.q: Which player gains memory from this card's effect?

Effect: [Main] Return 1 of your opponent's Digimon to the hand. Then, gain 1 memory for every 4 cards in your opponent's hand.
Security Effect: [Security] Return 1 of your opponent's Digimon to the hand.
